name: sistema-revision-pares
description: Sistema de Revisión por Pares - Monorepo

scripts.postinstall: npm run install:client && npm run install:microservices
scripts.install:microservices: concurrently -n usuarios,manuscritos,revision,matching,analisis-ia "cd microservices/usuarios && npm install" "cd microservices/manuscritos && npm install" "cd microservices/revision && npm install" "cd microservices/matching && npm install" "cd microservices/analisis-ia && npm install"
scripts.dev: npm run docker:up && npm run dev:client
scripts.dev:fresh: npm run docker:down:volumes && npm run dev
